Score Candidate Models on Outer Resampling Split(s)

Source: R/compare_censoring_weights.R
score_outer.Rd

A tidy wrapper around [glmnet_IBS()] using [furrr::future_map()] (or sequential [purrr::map()]) to evaluate a grid of candidate models across one or more outer resampling splits.

Usage

score_outer(
  object,
  grid,
  recipe,
  ...,
  censoring_weights = c("ipcw", "none"),
  coefficients = c("all", "nonzero"),
  seed = NULL,
  checkpoint_dir = NULL,
  checkpoint_mismatch = c("recompute", "overwrite", "error"),
  shard = NULL,
  chunk_size = NULL,
  on_complete = getOption("templecbe.on_complete", NULL),
  progress = FALSE
)

Arguments

object

An `rsplit` (e.g. from [rsample::initial_split()]), an `rset` / [rsample::nested_cv()] object containing outer splits, or a list of `rsplit` objects.

grid

A data frame or tibble defining candidate models to evaluate. Must contain an `alpha` column. If a `formula` or `formulas` column is present, each row's formula is passed to [glmnet_IBS()]. An optional `model` or `model_id` column will be preserved as the model identifier; if absent, one will be created.

recipe

A recipe object specifying preprocessing.

...

Additional arguments passed to [glmnet_IBS()] (such as `time_data`, `internal_folds`, `feature_names`, `id_col`, `cox.ties`, `covariates`, `rule`, `metric`, `tune_engine`).

censoring_weights

Weighting scheme: `"ipcw"` (default) or `"none"`.

coefficients

Option controlling which coefficients to store in the `coefficients` list column: `"all"` (default, includes predictors shrunk to 0) or `"nonzero"` (filters to non-zero estimates).

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducible model fitting across future plans.

checkpoint_dir

Optional directory path to save per-task checkpoint files. Finished tasks are loaded from disk on rerun when their fingerprint matches, skipping recomputation.

checkpoint_mismatch

Action when a checkpoint file in `checkpoint_dir` has a mismatched fingerprint: `"recompute"` (default; warns and recomputes), `"overwrite"` (recomputes and overwrites mismatched checkpoint files in place without warning; can also be enabled via `options(templecbe.checkpoint_mismatch = "overwrite")` or `options(templecbe.checkpoint_overwrite = TRUE)`), or `"error"` (stops immediately).

shard

Optional integer vector `c(i, n)` specifying that this machine should evaluate shard `i` of `n` into `checkpoint_dir`. Use [collect_checkpoints()] to merge all shards once finished.

chunk_size

Optional integer number of tasks per worker chunk passed to [furrr::furrr_options()] (default `NULL`, which lets furrr divide tasks evenly into one chunk per worker).

on_complete

Optional callback `function(result)` invoked when the run finishes or errors (defaults to `getOption("templecbe.on_complete", NULL)`).

progress

Show progress bar (default `FALSE`).

Value

A tibble with columns `outer_fold`, `model`, `alpha`, `formula` (if provided), `IBS` (integrated Brier score), `lambda`, and `coefficients` (list column of coefficient estimates).

See also

[glmnet_IBS()], [tidy_outer_coefficients()], [summarize_outer_importance()], [plot_outer_importance()], [collect_checkpoints()], [clean_checkpoints()], [compare_censoring_weights()], [select_candidate_models()]
